description: Served the 308th and 380th Bomb Wings; gate guard at Plattsburgh AFB from the 1960s and retained after closure; badly corroded for many years until a volunteer group Plattsburgh Aircraft Restoration began work in 2018; on loan from NMUSAF to the City of Plattsburgh; Aerial Visuals gives its latest location as Clyde Lewis Air Park Plattsburgh

Named The Outlaw with the 380th Bomb Wing in June 1989; mounted on a pedestal at Plattsburgh AFB and dedicated 3 Dec 1991; retained after the 1995 closure and now on loan from NMUSAF to the City of Plattsburgh; HMdb marker on the grounds of the Plattsburgh Air Force Base Museum fixes it at 44 deg 40.871 min N 73 deg 26.828 min W
